notes: QA audit batch 6 (v1.11.29): five Low bugs (BUG-050–054) + 4 Potential Issues (PI-01–PI-04). BUG-050: the topbar overall-progress summary and the Reset button no longer disappear below 700px — the summary drops to its own compact second row in the topbar and Reset stays visible in Settings. BUG-051: five dead i18n keys removed in both languages (testsLine, anOverdue, wrNextExam, issNone, anSubjTrendEmpty); parity now 988/988. BUG-052: the plan-execution trend no longer renders a misleading +۰٪ on a fresh state — it stays hidden when neither half has any execution. BUG-053: planned bars in the light theme use a darker #d7dce3 fill (was #eef0f3, ~1.1:1 on white) via a dedicated --an-bar-planned token; dark theme unchanged. BUG-054: the three English fragments inside Persian labels are translated — bkVersionsState now «نسخه‌های برنامه (وضعیت)», Gemini model limits are bilingual («حداکثر خروجی ۶۴ هزار توکن / ۱ میلیون توکن»), and the gemini-4-argon Persian description no longer references «Carbon». PI-01: the install-auto check-and-set on AUTO_UPDATE_ACTIVE is now atomic under AUTO_UPDATE_LOCK — two concurrent requests can no longer both start a download. PI-02: staging zip names now carry millisecond precision plus a random suffix, so two uploads in the same second never overwrite each other. PI-03: placeAfterLast treats a box ending exactly at 03:30 as the end of the study day (not the first box). PI-04: tombstones can now be cleared from the reconnect picker (with a confirm and a verified programme backup first) — a restored Google event with the same ID can be pulled again instead of being skipped forever. Known totals unchanged: حسابان 3489, شیمی 3000; گسسته and فیزیک have none (2110 not reintroduced). The 1.11.18 examDateText live-computation fix, the 1.11.27 delete-retry fix and the 1.11.28 batch-5 fixes are untouched.
